basic_info.description: Discover 2001 McAllister St.#242, where modern living meets NOPA's vibrant charm. This newly remodeled, corner 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom condo showcases a bright, open space flooded with natural light throughout and had been meticulously cared-for . The unit provides a great flow from the remodeled kitchen to the spacious living room and out to a balcony for some fresh air. The bedroom is your cozy retreat with a walk-in closet space, while the bathroom brings a touch of luxury with its updated finishes. The building itself offers peace of mind with a full-time on-site manager and security staff, plus the convenience of a Lucky grocery store within the building's the retail center. Living here means you're right in the middle of everything: minutes to USF, Haight or Divisadero, chill out in Golden Gate Park, or hop on public transit to explore the city. If you love good food, Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, and a bunch of cool restaurants in Cole Valley are just around the corner. It's the perfect mix of comfort, style, and convenience.
